$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Home section's Chief subagent sidebar rows (cx-d5b5d). scripts/cmux-next/gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants from it (its docstring is the row format); schemas/settings/settings-schema.json is still exported from Swift and must not change when rows move here.

lists.name: chiefSidebar
lists.note: Which Chief subagents get a workspace in the sidebar (a1018, Lawrence 2026-11-05: "the chief will make the decision if the workspace is visible in the sidebar or not", with heuristics the user shapes). Under auto the host shows a task that mentions a show word, hides one that mentions a hide word, else shows a task of at least the minimum words; the words listed add to the built-in ones (optchat-chief sidebar_choice.rs). Read at each spawn.

help.text: Automatic lets the Chief decide for each subagent: work you will want to watch or join shows, short errands stay hidden. Always and Never override the Chief.
Words or phrases that show a subagent when the Chief leaves it to these rules. They add to the built-in ones, such as UI, design, screenshots and needs you.
Words or phrases that keep a subagent hidden when the Chief leaves it to these rules. They add to the built-in ones, such as lookup, cleanup and land queue. A show word wins.
A task with no show or hide word shows when it has at least this many words, and stays hidden when it is shorter.

rows.name: showAll
rows.note: Every Chief subagent gets a sidebar workspace when it starts, whatever the Chief or the rules choose (the older Chief setting, read by the host from cmux-next.json at each spawn; unset there, the Chief's own optchat/settings.json value applies). Aziz 2026-11-05: the CLI wrote this key, but the host read only its own file, so it looked like it went back to false.

title.text: Show Each Subagent in the Sidebar

help.text: Each subagent the Chief starts gets its own workspace in the sidebar. Off, subagents run hidden and open from their links in the Chief's replies.

rows.name: closeFinished
rows.note: A finished subagent's workspace closes, for fewer workspaces in the sidebar. Off by default: only a tucked workspace (the collapsed Chief group) closes when its work ends; any other stays until the person closes it (Aziz 2026-11-05: "why are your agents disappearing from sidebar?"). Replaces OPTCHAT_SUBAGENT_ON_FINISH. Read by the host when a subagent finishes.

help.text: When a subagent finishes, its workspace closes, so the sidebar keeps fewer workspaces. Off, a subagent's workspace stays until you close it.
